interest: 1939 sighting of a suspicious Japanese vessel off Guam.
overview: Navy report of March 31, 1939: a radio-equipped vessel with fifteen Japanese seen off Guam's Uruno Point.

subfiles.about: A confidential U.S. Navy intelligence report detailing the sighting of a suspicious Japanese motorized vessel equipped with radio direction-finding gear off the northern coast of Guam.
subfiles.from: Commander G. W. Johnson, USN, Intelligence Officer
subfiles.summary: Commander Johnson reports that Guam's fish warden saw a radio-equipped vessel with about fifteen Japanese off Uruno Point on March 29, 1939. It fled, and police were ordered to search the jungle for landings.
subfiles.title: Intelligence Report on Movement of Japanese Vessel off Guam
